**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Downgrade the unsupported offline-suite status**

The reviewed tree's offline selection now contains 559 tests, so the cited 500-test run cannot establish that the current suite passes after this commit added further tests. The repository explicitly requires evidence to be invalidated when coverage is only partial; record the current suite's observed result or mark this status as partially/unverified instead of asserting a blanket pass.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep modal standing directives reviewable**

When an explicit rule has introductory wording, such as `I'd like you to always use uv` or `you must never use pip`, this regex no longer matches because `always`/`never` must immediately follow the start, punctuation, or a small conjunction list. The previous patterns matched these phrases, and they need not trigger any correction marker, so the gate now silently discards a subset of plainly stated standing preferences instead of reviewing them.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Clear inherited effort when opting into the CLI default**

When the parent environment already exports `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL` and the user sets `SELF_IMPROVE_REVIEW_EFFORT=""`, `review_effort()` returns `None` but this branch merely skips assignment, leaving the inherited effort in the copied environment. The documented empty-value escape hatch therefore does not accept the CLI default in that scenario; the `None` path needs to remove the inherited variable.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Limit the empty-value claim to supported dials**

When this instruction is followed for `SELF_IMPROVE_REVIEW_MODEL`, an empty value does not select the CLI's normal model: `review_model()` falls back to `DEFAULT_REVIEW_MODEL`, and `build_command()` still passes `--model sonnet`. This can make a model-specific reproduction run against the wrong reviewer model, so either document the escape hatch only for `SMOKE_MODEL` or implement distinct empty-versus-unset handling for the reviewer.
